notes.title: Cosmic Update
notes.notes:
This update adds a new level at the game's midpoint. In this level you'll work your way through some familiar celestial bodies.

There are additionally a few adjustments to gameplay balance for some of the existing levels and some of the hearts, and some bug fixes. And one other secret addition...

notes.title: Quick fix
notes.notes: Fixed a couple of bugs mostly related to Dominant heart

notes.title: New Hearts! And fixes and rebalances.
notes.notes:
Added Cold and Guarded hearts, two of the previously unreleased hearts that were shown in the trailer. As well as a third, DOMINANT.

Also fixed some bugs and made some balance changes, notably to the boss stages, removing unfair elements.
There is now more time to respond to the knight's javelin, and the knight takes a few more hits to defeat. 
The final boss can no longer type words that go offscreen.
Power mode hearts are now more adept at dealing with multiple gravity words at a time.
And very tall trees topple more slowly.

notes.title: First bug fix patch: Made the game a little less like Dark Souls
notes.notes:
Fixed several bugs, particularly ones involving Pure Heart and Dark Heart.
 - Pure Heart is almost entirely reworked. (It can now actually beat the game!)

Added a checkpoint to level 3.
